value: The malaria layer is the projection of the companion state-panel malaria analysis at the provisional June–September 2026 traditional ONI of +1.78 °C and RONI of +1.34 °C (the mean of the May–July, June–August and July–September 2026 seasons; the August–October season had not been published). The heat layer gives the scenarios of the companion state-panel heat analysis for a December–February 2026–27 traditional ONI of +1.5, +2.0 and +2.5 °C, because that season had not been published; these values are scenarios and are provisional. Both layers give expected excess recorded counts under a common national El Niño association, distributed by each unit's baseline burden; they are model-based extrapolations, not state-specific sensitivities. ENSO values are those published up to the July–September 2026 season.
